patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; 6sense leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs 6sense-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.
